To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the quark model is a powerful tool to describe the hadronic resonances, that the hadronic interactions are essential to explain the properties of the meson states and that the meson resonances in the charm sector are a rich source of information to constrain the low-energy realization of QCD.
the quark model is a very good description of hadronic physics and the new states reported in the meson sector are not a challenge to the quark model.
the low-energy QCD dynamics of the meson sector is described by an effective theory that contains the lowest order Fock state (quark-antiquar) and higher order components.
